player.name: string
player.weight_kg: null until a separate physical dataset is supplied
player.trophies: null because the upstream dataset has no trophy table

source_policy.clubs_and_leagues: appearances joined to clubs and competitions
source_policy.market_values: players fields derived from player_valuations upstream
source_policy.physical: Kept null when absent upstream; never estimated
source_policy.other_sources: Not permitted in the master player pool

derived_game_pools.xox: A rule-filtered view of the master pool; xox-rules.json remains authoritative.
derived_game_pools.career_twin: Reads the master pool directly and skips metrics without sufficient source coverage.

career_metric_definition.weight_kg: Reserved for a future separately supplied physical dataset.
career_metric_definition.club_count: Distinct clubs represented by official appearances in the dcaribou dataset.
career_metric_definition.trophies: Unavailable in dcaribou and therefore disabled.
career_metric_definition.career_goals: Goals in official senior-club appearances covered by dcaribou.
career_metric_definition.career_assists: Assists in official senior-club appearances covered by dcaribou.
career_metric_definition.peak_market_value_eur: Highest historical Transfermarkt market value in EUR.
career_metric_definition.career_appearances: Official senior-club appearances covered by dcaribou.
